$comment: Cite runs on a single contract. This file records that contract and the demo markets that were resolved on it.

contract.name: Cite

wallets.policy: Every wallet lives in D:\Genlayer-project\weels\wallet and is read from there. The GenLayer CLI store holds no copy of any key from this project.

project_wallet.name: cite
project_wallet.note: The project's own wallet, created for the next deployment.

creator.name: tester1
creator.note: Owner of the contract, so it is the only account that can withdraw fees or sweep stranded value.

contract.committee: The validators that voted are run by the network: gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-4.6, gemini-3-flash-preview, gpt-oss-120b, grok, qwen and glm, with three agreeing on every round.

demo_markets.name: tier1-jakarta-temperature
demo_markets.question: Will the maximum temperature in Jakarta on 14 October 2026 be at least 33.0 degrees Celsius?
demo_markets.note: ERA5 said 34.6 C and NASA POWER said 31.6 C. The committee reported the divergence and applied the locked authoritative source.

demo_markets.name: tier2-nws-alerts-new-york
demo_markets.shape: tier 2, metric counted from the event feed
demo_markets.question: Will the US National Weather Service have at least one alert in force for New York State on 14 October 2026?

demo_markets.name: tier2-nyc-hot-and-warning
demo_markets.question: Will New York reach 20.0 degrees Celsius on 14 October 2026 and have a warning in force that day?
demo_markets.note: The temperature came from the measurement source and the warning from the event source, and both had to hold.

demo_markets.name: tier2-gdacs-disasters-australia
demo_markets.question: Will GDACS record at least one orange or red disaster event affecting Australia between 1 and 20 October 2026?
demo_markets.note: The model reported ninety nine, the contract counted the qualifying records itself and the market settled on the contract's number.

accounting.note: A value transfer leaves the contract only when its child transaction is activated, so the strict reconciliation only holds once nothing is in flight. `covered` is the property that holds at every point in time.
